notes.title: Patch 1.0.07 is live!
notes.notes: -Save games will now check for certain Steam achievements and grant them if they have been attained. This is a fail-safe in the case and achievement does not get sent to Steam.

notes.title: Introducing French localization! Patch 1.0.06
notes.notes:
The new patch introduces the option to select French. If it's your first time opening Kiopioke, you will be prompted to select a language:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796076/6a268aaa9942c4d4f31c29532ced936c3ec7c807.png

If you already have opened the game, you can select the language from the options menu:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796076/9f24ae83a1b2d74ff8e01c685ab6ddf27b917bb9.png

Other fixes in this patch:
-Some adjustments to secret levels in Skynest should make the levels a bit more manageable.

notes.title: Kiopioke update patch 1.0.05
notes.notes:
Kiopioke was released just over a week ago and the Steam reviews have been amazing! Thanks to everyone who has played the game! I have also been gathering feedback from players and 
The first release patch is here! it addresses some control bugs:

-when using the D-Pad and triggering dialogue, the character will not continue moving without player input when the dialogue has ended.
-various level tweaks
-music load fixes

That's all for now!

notes.title: Demo 1.06 is now live, Ramping up for full release.
notes.notes:
Demo V1.06 adds fixes to the settings UI: resolutions and modes should work and save better than previously.

Kiopioke will now receive a bandage from Bullet! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796076/4336c60a73c7f31e528293027bc0c495a3d5dd55.png
Some minor character bugs have been fixed as well.

The game is getting close to complete. Most levels have been designed and built. The graphics are mostly made. Right now there is music to make and bugs to squash.

Steam NextFest (Summer edition) is fast approaching and I am very happy with the demo at the moment. It has reached this point thanks to the players who have been giving their feedback, so I would like to thank everyone that stopped by the Discord and shared their experience with me. I have introduced new control schemes and options and rebalanced levels because of this feedback. The demo (and eventually the game) will be more accessible because of this.

In the near future I would like to attempt to get Steam deck certified.  I will continue working on the game and getting to the finish line!

-hydr0k

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.05.
notes.notes:
There is a new control option available that allows the player to launch by releasing the Grab button. Visit Bullet's room in level 006 to learn more!

Notable changes/enhancements/fixes:

 New control option that launches when Grab is released.
 Better collision detection for hazards. This should reduce the "random" deaths that were occurring.
 Changes to HungryCat level. More forgiving than before.


Let's see your fastest time!

notes.title: Kiopioke! Demo: The last level has been retuned! Minor patch 1.03
notes.notes:
I've watched a few streams of new players and rebalanced some levels in the demo. If you haven't checked out the demo yet, there's no better time than now. If you have, try it again and beat your time!:

 Boss level has been rebalanced a bit
 minor edge case fixes to prevent unwarranted deaths
 Promotional link included in menus now


Thanks to everyone who has already tried the demo! More updates to come!

notes.title: Kiopioke! Demo, Minor update demo patch 1.02
notes.notes:
Based on feedback I have created a small patch of fixes:

 Input can now continue after dialogue boxes have been cleared. Allows movement immediately after dialogues.
 add navigation hints on menus so that navigation is clearer
 by default, Escape will now also act as a "back" button in menus
 difficulty has been re-tuned for the last level in Shielded Plateau


Thanks to everyone who has already tried the demo! More updates to come!
